snippet.title: Beast Unleashed | Teaser
snippet.description:
Step into the intense world of Beast Unleashed, a one-versus-many multiplayer game that immerses you in a grim fantasy realm where survival is not a guarantee.

Subscribe to the Beast Unleashed newsletter and receive a unique Bolgin skin — a special manifestation of the Marsh Bringer designed for our earliest supporters. 

Subscribe here: https://shorturl.at/O903G

Coming to Kickstarter September 1st, 2025
Follow now: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ebstudio/beast-unleashed
